notes: Transaction verified: CSI (Computer Services, Inc., core banking provider taken private by Centerbridge Partners and Bridgeport Partners in 2022) announced a definitive agreement to acquire Apiture on Aug 19, 2025 and completed the acquisition Oct 22, 2025. Both parties private and neither disclosed price or target financials; no credible source published a multiple. The only public financial breadcrumb is Live Oak Bancshares' ~$24M pre-tax gain on its (undisclosed-size) Apiture stake, insufficient for any valuation math.
